name: grok-search-web
description: ChatGPT web plugin for the hosted Grok Search OAuth app. No local bearer and no bundled MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Uses the workspace Grok Search OAuth app at https://search.karldigi.dev/mcp. This package does not bundle an MCP server, so ChatGPT web can install it.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search the web and cite the current sources.
